about: S07.7 (D.20): what the Family Hub and Digital Banking practice teaches and, explicitly, what it does not attempt. docs/operations/BLOCK-D-SCOPE-STATEMENT.md explains the statement, its quarterly human audit and the audit log; agent/tools/check-block-d-scope.mjs fails when a line loses its backing or its copy, a required exclusion or a mount disappears, or a borrowing, interest, insurance or investing mechanic appears in the schema without this statement changing.

notAttempted.basis: Appendix G §3.5: borrowing behaviour is more resistant to change than saving; programmes that move saving show null or adverse effects on credit (Bruhn et al. 2016).
Appendix G §3.2, §3.5: the Brazil RCT raised both saving and borrowing, attributed to inadequate coverage of credit risk.
Appendix G §2.4, §3.5: exponential-growth bias persists in adults (Stango & Zinman 2009); the weekly savings bonus is a family reward, not interest (D.11).
Appendix G §3.5: the simulation is debt-free and risk-free; it models no risk, insurance or investing.

publicAnswers.why: S07.8: D.20 asks for the statement in parent-facing material, and a parent weighing the product reads the marketing FAQ before any in-app screen.
